title: Biweekly drift flags & ops ledger — promptset onboarding triage
content:
TL;DR:
Two-week snapshot for promptset onboarding: overall drift index up 0.9 points (baseline 3.1 -> 4.0). Hallucination and formatting regressions dominate; cold-cache truncation incident on 2026-05-22 caused ~18% latency tail increase for affected routes. This ledger collects flagged promptsets, quick mitigations, owners, and follow-ups for the next sprint.

Metrics snapshot (last 14d):
- Drift index (weighted): 4.0 (was 3.1) — threshold 4.5 for high-severity alert.
- Failure-rate (visible regressions across promptsets): 6.7% -> 9.4%
- Top error contributors by token-volume: hallucination (41%), unexpected-format (27%), truncation/cutoff (18%), runtime-errors (8%), policy/hits (6%)
- Median latency (p90) across onboarding routes: 210ms -> 248ms (cold-cache episodes accounted for ~35ms of the delta)

Top failure modes (triage summary):
1) Hallucination on fact-based extraction prompts — common when model variant bumped to v2.1-quant. Symptoms: confident but incorrect numeric values, invented citations.
2) Output-format drift — prompts expecting strict JSON are now returning extra commentary lines (likely due to few-shot prime mismatch).
3) Prefix-truncation after cache warmup — long context promptsets occasionally drop earlier tokens when KV cache eviction policy triggers.
4) Latency spikes from cold KV cache (single-region rollout experiment).

Promptsets flagged (priority order):
- ps-claims-extract-2026-05 (owner: Marcus Li) — hallucination spikes after quantized model rollout.
- ps-billing-formatters-q2 (owner: Zoë Anders) — JSON schema breaks, tests failing 32% of cases.
- ps-long-context-user-hist (owner: Gina Ramirez) — truncation observed on sequences > 8k tokens when traffic pattern changes.

Immediate mitigations (48–72h):
- Revert model variant for high-severity promptsets to previous float32 variant where hallucination jumped (Marcus). Ticket JIRA-ML-8723 subtask attached.
- Apply stricter format guardrail: wrap generation in deterministic JSON wrapper + post-parse validator; for failing promptsets, return safe fallback with error code instead of freeform text (Zoë).
- Short-term KV cache config rollback on the canary region (Gina) to avoid further cold-cache truncation while we analyze eviction heuristics.
- Add token-level sampling clamp (temperature 0.0–0.2) on extraction promptsets for the next 48h to reduce invented values (owner: Marcus).

Owners & deadlines: 
- Marcus Li: rollback model variant and apply sampling clamp — deadline 2026-05-29 EOD.
- Zoë Anders: deploy JSON wrapper + unit tests to edge route — deadline 2026-05-30 midday.
- Gina Ramirez: revert KV config on canary and run synthetic long-context load test — deadline 2026-05-28 morning.
- Priya Desai (triage lead): consolidate eval artifacts and run targeted prompt-level scoring suite for flagged sets — deadline 2026-05-31.

Longer-term actions (sprint+):
- Build a small re-eval job for ps-claims-extract against a curated ground-truth set to measure factuality delta post-quantization. Candidate: use the existing eval harness + new reference table (Confluence-ONBOARD-1345).
- Add schema-constrained generation tasks to CI for billing formatters; convert flaky prompts into supervised conversion rules where feasible.
- Investigate KV cache eviction heuristics: instrument per-request KV hits and align eviction windows with common long-context promptsets.
- Consider hybrid model routing: keep a float32 variant behind a low-latency route for high-risk promptsets while routing lower-risk traffic to quantized variants.

Notes and open questions (team discussion points):
- Is the hallucination delta correlated with prompt length or with model param-quantization only? Quick analysis: early signal suggests quantization amplifies soft errors on numeric hallucination — need targeted ablation.
- For the JSON wrapper approach, what's the expected cost overhead in tokens + latency? Planning estimate: ~5–12% token overhead on affected routes. Tradeoff: fail-safe correctness vs cost.
- How do we make the rollback path less “manual”? Proposal: Add a one-click route flag in console to pin model variant per-route (Priya to raise with product console team).

Quick checklist (do before next sync):
- [ ] Confirm model rollback for ps-claims-extract and monitor drift metric for 24h.
- [ ] Deploy JSON wrapper to staging and run format-conformance suite.
- [ ] Re-run long-context synthetic test across canary after KV config revert.
- [ ] Attach eval artifacts (raw prompts + model outputs) to JIRA subtask for triage.

Meeting cadence: triage sync Tuesday/Thursday 10:30am PT for daily owners updates until status is green. Weekend on-call: Marcus + Gina.

Random notes / scratch:
- Saw a small cluster of policy-hits on billing-formatters (may be caused by examples containing named entities) — low priority but mention to security for FYI.
- If JSON wrapper reduces false positives by > 60% we should consider templating that as a lightweight SDK helper.

Attachments to add to ticket: ps-claims-extract-logs-20260522.zip, billing-format-fail-sample.csv, long-context-synthetic-results-20260527.json

End ledger — updates to this doc will be appended as action items are completed.
